data.body:
[P2] Include the permission for IAM-derived provisioned credentials

The connection code accepts a provisioned cluster without `dbUser` or `secretArn`, using the caller's IAM identity. That authentication mode requires `redshift:GetClusterCredentialsWithIAM`, which this new list omits; `redshift:GetClusterCredentials` covers the explicitly supplied database-user mode. Following the instruction to grant only these actions therefore leaves connection checks and queries unauthorized for a supported configuration. Add `redshift:GetClusterCredentialsWithIAM` and distinguish which credential permission each authentication mode requires.
